summary: A 10-hour private car charter between Osaka, Kyoto and Nara, with airport options and a discounted 2-day package.
body:
## What this is

This is a private car charter in the Kansai region. For ten hours you have a vehicle and driver to travel between Osaka, Kyoto and Nara in whatever order you like, stopping for food or photos when you want. KKday lists it as a good value choice for hopping between the three cities with luggage or a group.

## Options on the listing

The page offers four choices. The 10-hour private charter tour starts at US$245.10. A 10-hour charter that starts or ends at Kansai Airport (KIX) with Osaka, Kyoto or Kobe starts at US$284.64. A discounted 2-day private self-guided package of 10 hours plus 10 hours starts at US$600.90. A child seat can be added from the second seat onward for US$15.26.

## Hours and area

Service hours begin at 07:00 at the earliest and end by 22:00. The service area is Osaka City, Kyoto City and Nara City, and the page says pick-up and drop-off points follow each plan's route.

## When to go

The page notes that the best time for autumn foliage is November to December and the best time for cherry blossoms is mid-March to mid-May, subject to the weather.

## Booking and cancellation

Confirmation is instant. Free cancellation applies up to 2 days before the date. The page shows a very high rating of 4.9 from 1,409 reviews and more than 9 thousand bookings; these are KKday's figures.

## What the excerpt does not say

The text we read did not state the driver's language for this product or what happens when you go over the ten hours. Check both in the details before booking.

## When it fits

It suits a group or family that wants to see several Kansai sights in a day or two without buying train tickets for each leg, and to start at the airport without a transfer.
